The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an 'I can do that' mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

About The Position: We are seeking a highly motivated, resilient, and results-driven Outbound Business Development Representative to join our fast-growing company. In this role, you won't be waiting for leads to come to you—you will be the engine driving our front-line growth.

As an Outbound BDR, you will focus strictly on net-new business acquisition, identifying high-value targets, mapping out key decision-makers, and executing rigorous cold outreach strategies.

The ideal candidate is a true hunter with a passion for the thrill of the chase, excellent objection-handling skills, and a strategic mindset for penetrating cold accounts. This is an exciting opportunity to be a critical pipeline driver in a high-growth SaaS environment. What You Will Do:

Drive Outbound Pipeline: Proactively prospect, map, and penetrate target accounts using a mix of multi-channel outreach, including high-volume cold calling, personalized email sequences, LinkedIn video/voice notes, and other creative social selling tactics.

Execute Strategic Account Mapping: Research enterprise and mid-market organizations to identify key decision-makers (C-level, HR Leaders, CFOs) and uncover hidden pain points related to global expansion.

Own the First Touch: Conduct high-impact discovery conversations with cold prospects, effectively educating them on G-P’s Employer of Record (EOR) value proposition, overcoming initial friction, and booking qualified meetings for the Account Executive team.

Manage Objections: Confidently navigate gatekeepers and handle complex objections regarding global payroll, compliance, and competing solutions.

Data-Driven Prospecting: Maintain meticulous records of your outreach sequences, account maps, and conversion metrics within our CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools (e.g., Outreach/Salesloft).

Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of macroeconomic trends, geopolitical shifts, and competitor movements to sharply position G-P as the definitive global employment solution.

Hit the Numbers: Consistently meet or exceed monthly quotas for cold outreach activity, qualified opportunities generated, and pipeline contribution.

The Hunter Mindset: Proven track record in a pure outbound sales development, lead generation, or cold-calling heavy role (SaaS experience highly preferred).

Resilience & Grit: High emotional intelligence with the ability to handle rejection professionally, pivot strategies quickly, and maintain high energy throughout the day.

Prospecting Skills: Will to learn and use tools (e.g. Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesforce,).

Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to write highly personalized, compelling cold copy that cuts through the noise.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to understand complex business models and articulate how a global EOR platform solves specific corporate expansion pain points.

Self-Starter: Highly organized, disciplined, and capable of managing a high volume of outbound activity independently in a remote-first environment.

Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the Employer of Record industry, HR outsourcing, global payroll, or workforce management is a massive plus but not essential

Education: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not essential

* Strong conceptual skills combined with the ability to condense complex issues into crisp key messages and to craft compelling PowerPoint presentations

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist.

You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point.

We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English & German is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
